title: Sallow Reservoir: the first job's walk
intro: The career's first job in Sallow (bring the scour key to the Valve house, scour_key), then on to the nearest way out, the Gauge house: 570 m in all, in the valley's reference weather. Walked by the procedure in `docs/craft/WALK_REVIEW.md`; shots from `walk.stills`, stops from `stops.json`.

s01.vista: A road into misted pines and birches.
s01.discover: Side: more birches, a roof faint.
s01.for: The drop: a road into the trees.

s02.vista: The road on, a grey wall far ahead in the mist (the dam).
s02.for: A fork, the dam's wall the only subject.

s03.vista: The road on toward the dam, a boulder and a birch by the fork.

s04.vista: Arriving, a brick wall and a rusted door fill the frame.
s04.discover: Side: the Valve house's corner, the trees.
s04.for: 'You're there' as a wall: the job's place is a door you stand at.

s05.vista: The dam's foot: a long masonry wall over you on the right, a hut far ahead.
s05.discover: Side: the valve house and a hut by the dam.
s05.for: Under the dam: it should be awe; it's a corridor.

s06.vista: A path between the dam's wall and a bank, a lamp far up.

s07.vista: Up the dam's side, the draw-off tower's lamp, pines beyond.
s07.discover: Side: the valve house's roof below.

s08.vista: The path up between walls, the tower's lamp close.

s09.vista: On the dam top: a road along it, the filter house's wall and lamp.
s09.discover: Side: the filter house and its tower.
s09.for: Topping the dam, but the water isn't in the frame.

s10.vista: Open grass, a boulder, a road bending away.
s10.discover: Side: the filter house and its lamps.

s11.vista: Grass and the far woods, a shed's corner.

s12.vista: The shore road along the reservoir's mud, a beacon faint ahead.
s12.for: The way out begins to show.

s13.vista: The road by the water, a gantry in the reservoir, the beacon.
s13.discover: Side: a bank and a boulder.

s14.vista: The road under the bank, the reservoir's flats.

s15.vista: The road on, the beacon closer, the flats.
s15.discover: Side: the bank and its trees.

s16.vista: The gauge house's brick corner and a bank.
s16.discover: Side: the beacon's pole, the gauge house.
s16.for: Arrived; the beacon is beside, not ahead.

notes: A wall in your face (s04): the scour key's job ends at the valve house door, nose to the brick; there's no frame of the place.

A corridor under the dam (s05 to s08, 120 to 240 m): the route runs along the dam's foot between its wall and a bank. The dam should be the valley's awe; here it's a wall you walk beside, and the reservoir is never seen.
A reveal with nothing in it (s09): on the dam top the water should open out; the frame looks along the road at the filter house instead.
The rest is calm and plain: the shore road to the Gauge house is fine, if long.

fixes.title: 1. The valve house's arrival (s04)
fixes.what: The scour key lies on the valve house's floor, so the job's point stays in it; the arrival is now framed 20 m out as you come up the road (scripts/walk_stops.py): the valve house with the dam's wall behind it in the mist, not a door at arm's length. The door already faced the way in.

fixes.title: 2. The dam's top (s09): a viewing bay
fixes.what: On the crest the parapet stood at eye height along the road, so topping the dam showed a wall. Models opened a 6 m railed bay in the upstream parapet at x 91-97, straight across from the face stair's landing: from it, looking north, the ground falls away over the bed (in the reference weather, into mist). The crest stop's view is the bay's (s09_bay in walk.stills). The face's foot (buttresses, staining) was tried and dropped: from the route the face stair hides it, and at 40 m it's fog.

fixes.title: 3. The dam's face, whole, before you're under it (s04, s05)
fixes.what: The face was there; the walk didn't look at it. Coming up to the valve house, 20 m out, the face runs the whole frame to the north-west, stepping down with the stair's walls: the reveal before the corridor (s04's side view, now the face: scripts/walk_stops.py counts dam_face as a landmark). Past the valve house, at the face's foot looking along it, it towers: the threshold into the walk beside it. No scenery moved.
